name: Coconut Harvester
body:
Coconut Harvester CR 1/2

XP 400
N Medium humanoid (human)
Human expert 2
Init +2; Senses Perception +6

DEFENSE

AC 13, touch 12, flat-footed 11 (+2 Dex, +1 armor)
hp 9 (2d8)
Fort +0, Ref +2, Will +4

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee mwk sickle +4 (1d6+2)
Ranged blowgun +3 (1d2)

STATISTICS

Str 14, Dex 14, Con 10, Int 10, Wis 12, Cha 8
Base Atk +1; CMB +3; CMD 15
Feats Athletic, Skill Focus (Climb)
Skills Acrobatics +7, Climb +13*, Heal +5, Knowledge (nature) +5, Perception +6, Profession (coconut harvester) +5, Stealth +6, Survival +6, Swim +8; * +15 when using climber’s kit
Languages Common
Gear quilted cloth armor, masterwork sickle, blowgun with 10 darts, hunting knife, waterskin, compass, climber’s kit, bedroll, backpack

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Monkey Limbs (Ex)

Whenever a coconut harvester makes a successful Climb check, they can move one-half their land speed (instead of one-quarter speed).

Sage Climber (Ex)

A coconut harvester adds their Wisdom bonus in addition to their Strength bonus on Climb checks.
